15.odr_com: and calling the name of that place, Bethel.
15.sabates_a: and calling the name of that place, Bethel.
15.madueke_b: and calling the name of that place, Bethel.

16.s_dismas: And being gone forth from thence, he came in the ſpring time to the land which leadeth to Ephrata: wherin when Rachel was in trauaile,
16.odr_com: And being gone forth from thence, he came in the spring time to the land which leadeth to Ephrata: wherin when Rachel was in trauaile,
16.sabates_a: And being gone forth from thence, he came in the spring time to the land which leadeth to Ephrata: wherein when Rachel was in travail,
16.madueke_b: And being gone forth from thence, he came in the spring time to the land which leadeth to Ephrata: wherein when Rachel was in travail,

17.s_dismas: becauſe of difficultie in her trauaile, ſhe beganne to be in danger, and the midwife ſaid vnto her: Feare not, for thou shalt haue alſo this a ſonne.
17.odr_com: because of difficultie in her trauaile, she beganne to be in danger, and the midwife said vnto her: Feare not, for thou shalt haue also this a sonne.
17.sabates_a: because of difficulty in her travail, she began to be in danger, and the midwife said unto her: Fear not, for thou shalt have also this a son.
17.madueke_b: because of difficulty in her travail, she began to be in danger, and the midwife said unto her: Fear not, for thou shalt have also this a son.

18.s_dismas: And her ſoule departing for paine, and death now at hand, she called the name of her ſonne Benoni, that is the ſonne of my paine: but his father called him Beniamin, that is the ſonne of the right hand.
18.odr_com: And her soule departing for paine, and death now at hand, she called the name of her sonne Benoni, that is the sonne of my paine: but his father called him Beniamin, that is the sonne of the right hand.
18.sabates_a: And her soul departing for pain, and death now at hand, she called the name of her son Benoni, that is the son of my pain: but his father called him Benjamin, that is the son of the right hand.
18.madueke_b: And her soul departing for pain, and death now at hand, she called the name of her son Benoni, that is the son of my pain: but his father called him Benjamin, that is the son of the right hand.

19.s_dismas: Rachel therfore died, and was buried in the hye way that leadeth to Ephrata, this ſame is Bethleem.
19.odr_com: Rachel therfore died, and was buried in the hye way that leadeth to Ephrata, this same is Bethleem.
19.sabates_a: Rachel therefore died, and was buried in the high way that leadeth to Ephrata, this same is Bethleem.
19.madueke_b: Rachel therefore died, and was buried in the high way that leadeth to Ephrata, this same is Bethleem.

20.s_dismas: And Iacob erected a title ouer her ſepulchre: This is the title of Rachels monument, vntil this preſent day.
20.odr_com: And Iacob erected a title ouer her sepulchre: This is the litle of Rachels monument, vntil this present day.
20.sabates_a: And Jacob erected a title over her sepulchre: This is the title of Rachel's monument, until this present day.
20.madueke_b: And Jacob erected a title over her sepulchre: This is the title of Rachel's monument, until this present day.

21.s_dismas: Departing thence, he pitched his tent beyond the Flocke tower.
21.odr_com: Departing thence, he pitched his tent beyond the Flocke tower.
21.sabates_a: Departing thence, he pitched his tent beyond the Flock tower.
21.madueke_b: Departing thence, he pitched his tent beyond the Flock tower.

22.s_dismas: And when he dwelt in that countrie: Ruben went, and ſlept with Bala his fathers concubine: which thing he was not ignorant of. And the ſonnes of Iacob were twelue.
22.odr_com: And when he dwelt in that countrie: Ruben went, and slept with Bala his fathers concubine: which thing he was not ignorant of. And the sonnes of Iacob were twelue.
22.sabates_a: And when he dwelt in that country, Ruben went, and slept with Bala his father's concubine: which thing he was not ignorant of. And the sons of Jacob were twelve.
22.madueke_b: And when he dwelt in that country, Ruben went, and slept with Bala his father's concubine: which thing he was not ignorant of. And the sons of Jacob were twelve.

23.s_dismas: The ſonnes of Lia: Ruben the firſt begotten, and Simeon, and Leui, and Iudas, and Iſſachar, and Zabulon.
23.odr_com: The sonnes of Lia: Ruben the first begotten, and Simeon, and Leui, and Iudas, and Issachar, and Zabulon.
23.sabates_a: The sons of Lia: Ruben the first begotten, and Simeon, and Levi, and Judas, and Issachar, and Zabulon.
23.madueke_b: The sons of Lia: Ruben the first begotten, and Simeon, and Levi, and Judas, and Issachar, and Zabulon.

24.s_dismas: The ſonnes of Rachel: Ioſeph and Beniamin.
24.odr_com: The sonnes of Rachel: Ioseph and Beniamin.
24.sabates_a: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.
24.madueke_b: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.

25.s_dismas: The ſonnes of Bala Rachels handmaid: Dan and Nepthali.
25.odr_com: The sonnes of Bala Rachels handmaid: Dan and Nepthali.
25.sabates_a: The sons of Bala Rachel's handmaid: Dan and Nephthali.
25.madueke_b: The sons of Bala Rachel's handmaid: Dan and Nephthali.

26.s_dismas: The ſonnes of Zelpha Lias handmaid: Gad and Aſer: theſe are the ſonnes of Iacob, that were borne to him in Meſopotamia of Siria.
26.odr_com: The sonnes of Zelpha Lias handmaid: Gad and Aser: these are the sonnes of Iacob, that were borne to him in Mesopotamia of Siria.
26.sabates_a: The sons of Zelpha Lia's handmaid: Gad and Aser: these are the sons of Jacob, that were born to him in Mesopotamia of Syria.
26.madueke_b: The sons of Zelpha Lia's handmaid: Gad and Aser: these are the sons of Jacob, that were born to him in Mesopotamia of Syria.

27.s_dismas: He came alſo to Iſaac his father in Mambre, the citie of Arbee, this is Hebron: wherin Abraham and Iſaac ſoiourned.
27.odr_com: He came also to Isaac his father in Mambre, the citie of Arbee, this is Hebron: wherin Abraham and Isaac soiourned.
27.sabates_a: He came also to Isaac his father in Mambre, the city of Arbee, this is Hebron: wherein Abraham and Isaac sojourned.
27.madueke_b: He came also to Isaac his father in Mambre, the city of Arbee, this is Hebron: wherein Abraham and Isaac sojourned.

28.s_dismas: And the dayes of Iſaac were complete an hundred eyghtie yeares.
28.odr_com: And the dayes of Isaac were complete an hundred eyghtie yeares.
28.sabates_a: And the days of Isaac were complete an hundred eighty years.
28.madueke_b: And the days of Isaac were complete an hundred eighty years.

29.s_dismas: And ſpent with age he died, and was put to his people, being old and ful of dayes: and Eſau and Iacob his ſonnes buryed him.
29.odr_com: And spent With age he died, and was put to his people, being old and ful of dayes: and Esau and Iacob his sonnes buryed him.
29.sabates_a: And spent with age he died, and was put to his people, being old and full of days, and Esau and Jacob his sons buried him.
29.madueke_b: And spent with age he died, and was put to his people, being old and full of days, and Esau and Jacob his sons buried him.

janvier_by_verse.1: In the mean time God spake to Jacob: Arise, and go up to Bethel, and dwell there, and make an altar to God that appeared to thee when thou didst fly from Esau thy brother.
janvier_by_verse.2: And Jacob having called together all his house, said: Cast away the strange gods that are among you, and be cleansed and change your garments.
janvier_by_verse.3: Arise, and let us go up into Bethel, that we may make there an altar unto God: who herd me in the day of my tribulation, and accompanied me in my journey.
janvier_by_verse.4: They gave to him therefore all the strange gods that they had, and the earlets which were in their ears: but he buried them under the terebinth that is behind the city of Sichem.
janvier_by_verse.5: And when they were departed, the terror of God invaded all the cities round about, and they durst not pursue them going away.
janvier_by_verse.6: And Jacob came to Luza, which is in the land of Chanaan, surnamed Bethel: he and all the people that was with him.
janvier_by_verse.7: And he builded there an altar, and called the name of that place, The house of God: for there God appeared to him when he fled from his brother.
janvier_by_verse.8: The same time died Debora the nurse of Rebecca, and was buried at the foot of Bethel under an oak: and the name of that place was called The oak of weeping.
janvier_by_verse.9: And God appeared again to Jacob after he returned from Mesopotamia of Syria, and he blessed him,
janvier_by_verse.10: saying: Thou shalt not be called any more Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name. And he called him Israel,
janvier_by_verse.11: and said to him: I am God Almighty, increase thou and multiply: Of thee shall be nations and peoples of nations, kings shall come forth of thy loins.
janvier_by_verse.12: And the land which I gave to Abraham and Isaac, I will give to thee, and to thy seed after thee.
janvier_by_verse.14: But he erected a title of stone in the place where God had spoken unto him: offering upon it liquid offerings, and pouring oil on it,
janvier_by_verse.15: and calling the name of that place, Bethel.
janvier_by_verse.16: And being gone forth from thence, he came in the spring time to the land which leadeth to Ephrata: wherein when Rachel was in travail,
janvier_by_verse.17: because of difficulty in her travail, she began to be in danger, and the midwife said unto her: Fear not, for thou shalt have also this a son.
janvier_by_verse.18: And her soul departing for pain, and death now at hand, she called the name of her son Benoni, that is the son of my pain: but his father called him Benjamin, that is the son of the right hand.
janvier_by_verse.19: Rachel therefore died, and was buried in the high way that leadeth to Ephrata, this same is Bethleem.
janvier_by_verse.20: And Jacob erected a title over her sepulchre: This is the title of Rachel's monument, until this present day.
janvier_by_verse.21: Departing thence, he pitched his tent beyond the Flock tower.
janvier_by_verse.22: And when he dwelt in that country, Ruben went, and slept with Bala his father's concubine: which thing he was not ignorant of. And the sons of Jacob were twelve.
janvier_by_verse.23: The sons of Lia: Ruben the first begotten, and Simeon, and Levi, and Judas, and Issachar, and Zabulon.
janvier_by_verse.24: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.

janvier_by_verse.26: The sons of Zelpha Lia's handmaid: Gad and Aser: these are the sons of Jacob, that were born to him in Mesopotamia of Syria.
janvier_by_verse.27: He came also to Isaac his father in Mambre, the city of Arbee, this is Hebron: wherein Abraham and Isaac sojourned.
janvier_by_verse.28: And the days of Isaac were complete an hundred eighty years.
